summary: RE-TEST of iteration_41 fix: PASSED end-to-end. Moving readerQrUrl/readerQrLoading/openReaderQr from MortsInsightsPanel into the top-level App component successfully resolved the ReferenceError crash on Settings click. All 6 requested test steps now succeed. Both QR codes (Reader + Mort Buddy) encode farm+token and resolve correctly when opened directly.
critical_code_review_comments: App.tsx is still >14,000 lines — extremely hard to maintain. Strongly recommend splitting into per-view files (SettingsModal, MortsInsightsPanel, ProgramView, etc.) so scope bugs like the iteration_41 crash cannot recur.
Consider adding a Playwright/Vitest smoke test that opens Settings after magic-link login (would have caught iteration_41 crash immediately in CI).

Reader QR (in App) and Staff QR (in MortsInsightsPanel) call the same /api/farm-token endpoint but use two independent state pairs (readerQrUrl/readerQrLoading vs qrUrl/qrLoading). Consider unifying into one shared hook (useFarmToken) — reduces duplication and reduces likelihood of another scope bug.
test_credentials: Owner magic link with OWNER_MAGIC_KEY, farm=default (Double B Farm)
seed_data_creation: None — no test data written to DB. Only /api/farm-token GET calls (read-only, HMAC-derived token).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified test procedure that works: 1) hit /api/auth/owner-magic?...&to=/ (redirects to /landing due to SPA landing logic — that's OK), 2) navigate to /?farm=default (loads Program SPA authenticated), 3) dismiss any Skip-tour button, 4) click [data-testid=open-settings-drawer], 5) confirm [data-testid=reader-qr-code] renders, 6) read the QR value via React fiber walk (walk cur[__reactFiber*].return chain looking for memoizedProps.value containing '/reader?farm='). Staff QR is under the 'Mort Buddy' tab in the top toolbar — [data-testid=morts-staff-qr-btn] opens modal with [data-testid=morts-staff-qr-url]. Both URLs open reader.html/morts-entry.html correctly in a fresh unauthenticated context (token in ?t= grants farm-scoped access).

rca of the issue: Original bug (iteration_41): scope bug — new openReaderQr/readerQrUrl/readerQrLoading hooks were declared inside MortsInsightsPanel child component but referenced in the top-level App component's Settings button onClick and Send-to-Phone QR JSX. React threw ReferenceError at render, unmounting the tree. Fix (verified this iteration at App.tsx lines 10194-10223): declarations moved into App() before its return, so App's Settings onClick (line 12423) and QR render block (lines 13916-13922) now resolve correctly. Build (dist/public/assets/index-BlKqXywq.js, mtime 20s after App.tsx) contains the fix. All 6 requested tests pass — the very frustrated user's P0 QR-linking issue is fully resolved.
